reasoning: This is a Hebrew manuscript compilation of Hasidic discourses (ma'amarim) by both Dov Baer Schneursohn and Shneur Zalman, matching the Manchester Gaster series (MS 1351/1357). Named individual works exist in English (Tanya, Torah Or, Tract on Ecstasy, Gate of Unity, Flames), but no prior English translation of this specific manuscript compilation—nor of Dov Baer's comprehensive discourse corpus (Maamarei Admur HaEmtza'i, 20 vols)—has been found across WorldCat, Sefaria, Kehot catalog, Chabad.org, and academic bibliographies.
